transcript.en: Good morning.
transcript.zh: 上午好。

transcript.en: Welcome to the Early Learning Childcare Centre.
transcript.zh: 欢迎来到早教托儿所。

transcript.en: How may I help you?
transcript.zh: 有什么能帮您？

transcript.en: Hi.I spoke to you last week about enrolling my daughter for next year.
transcript.zh: 您好，我上星期和您说过明年要把我的女儿托管在这儿。

transcript.en: Oh yes.I'll just get some details from you.
transcript.zh: 哦，对。那我接下来了解一下您的个人信息。

transcript.en: So you're her mother?
transcript.zh: 您是她的母亲？没错。

transcript.en: That's right.
transcript.zh: 没错。

transcript.en: And can I have your name?
transcript.zh: 您的名字是？

transcript.en: It's Carol	 Carol Smith.
transcript.zh: 我叫Carol， Carol Smith。

transcript.en: And your daughter's name?
transcript.zh: 您的女儿叫什么名字？

transcript.en: It's Kate.
transcript.zh: 她叫Kate。

transcript.en: Now	 we have several groups at the centre and we cater for children from three to five years old.
transcript.zh: 我们托儿所有好几个组，接收的是三到五岁的孩子。

transcript.en: How old is your daughter?
transcript.zh: 您的女儿今年多大了？

transcript.en: She's three now but she turns four next month.
transcript.zh: 她现在三岁，不过下个月就四岁了。

transcript.en: I'll put four down because that's how old she'll be when she starts.
transcript.zh: 那我就写四岁了，因为等她来我们托儿所的时候就是四岁。

transcript.en: Fine, she's so excited about her birthday and coming to the centre.
transcript.zh: 好的，她对过生日和来托儿所都觉得非常兴奋。

transcript.en: That's good to hear.
transcript.zh: 那太好了。

transcript.en: And what's your address?
transcript.zh: 您的地址是？

transcript.en: It's 46 Wombat Road that's W-O-M-B-A-T.
transcript.zh: Wombat路46号，路名的拼写是WOMBAT。

transcript.en: Woodside 4032.
transcript.zh: Woodside小区4032。

transcript.en: And what's the phone number?
transcript.zh: 您的电话号码是多少？

transcript.en: So have you decided on the days you'd like to bring your daughter here?
transcript.zh: 好的，您决定好了哪几天把您的女儿托管在这儿吗？

transcript.en: I'd prefer Monday and Wednesday if possible.
transcript.zh: 如果可以的话，我想定在周一和周三。

transcript.en: Mmm.I'll check Monday's fine	 but I think the centre is already full for Wednesday.
transcript.zh: 嗯......我看一下......周一没问题，不过恐怕周三那天我们托儿所已经订满了。

transcript.en: Erm. Yes. Sorry. It seems to be a very popular day.
transcript.zh: 对，是订满了，不好意思。周三似乎大家都很忙。

transcript.en: We can offer you a Thursday or a Friday as well.
transcript.zh: 您也可以选择周四或者周五过来啊。

transcript.en: Oh dear.
transcript.zh: 天呐，

transcript.en: I suppose Thursday would be all right because she has swimming on Friday.
transcript.zh: 我想周四应该也可以，因为她周五有游泳课。

transcript.en: OK, got that.
transcript.zh: 好的，知道了。

transcript.en: Because a lot of parents work, we do offer flexible start and finish times.
transcript.zh: 由于很多家长都要上班，所以我们的开始和结束时间比较灵活。

transcript.en: We are open from 7:30 in the morning until 6 o'clock at night.
transcript.zh: 我们托儿所从早上7：30营业到晚上6点。

transcript.en: What time would you like your daughter to start?
transcript.zh: 您想几点把女儿送过来呢？

transcript.en: I need to get to work in the city by 9:00 so I'll drop her off at 8:30.
transcript.zh: 我9点之前要去市里上班，所以我8:30的时候会把她送过来。

transcript.en: You're pretty close to the city here so that should give me plenty of time to get there.
transcript.zh: 你们这儿离市里挺近的，所以我要去公司应该还有充足的时间。

transcript.en: That's fine.
transcript.zh: 很好。

transcript.en: Now we also need to decide which group she'll be in.
transcript.zh: 那么我们现在还需要决定把您的女儿放在哪个小组。

transcript.en: We have two different groups and they're divided up according to age.
transcript.zh: 我们这儿根据年龄分成了两个不同的小组。

transcript.en: There's the green group	 which is for three to four year olds.
transcript.zh: 一个小组是绿组，里面都是3到4岁的孩子。

transcript.en: And then there's the red group which is for four to five year olds.
transcript.zh: 另一个小组是红组，专为4到5岁的孩子成立的。

transcript.en: She's quite mature for her age and she can already write her name and read a little.
transcript.zh: 我的女儿在她这个年纪算是比较成熟的了，她已经会写自己的名字了，而且还认识一些字。

transcript.en: Well, I'll put her in the red group and we can always change her to the green one if there are any problems.
transcript.zh: 这样啊，那就把她放在红组吧，如果有任何问题，我们随时都可以把她换到绿组去。

transcript.en: That sounds fine.
transcript.zh: 听起来不错。

transcript.en: OK.
transcript.zh: 好的。

transcript.en: Let's move on to meals.
transcript.zh: 那我们继续讲一讲吃饭问题吧。

transcript.en: We can provide breakfast lunch and dinner.
transcript.zh: 我们这儿早餐、午餐和晚餐都可以提供。

transcript.en: As she's finishing pretty early, she won't need dinner, will you give her breakfast before she comes?
transcript.zh: 因为您来接她的时候还蛮早的，她就不需要在这儿吃晚饭了，您在送她来之前会给她吃早餐吗？

transcript.en: Yes, she'll only need lunch.
transcript.zh: 会的，她只需要在这儿吃午饭。

transcript.en: Now, does she have any medical conditions we need to know about?
transcript.zh: 她有什么需要我们注意的身体状况吗？

transcript.en: Does she have asthma or any hearing problems for example?
transcript.zh: 比如有没有哮喘或者任何听力障碍？

transcript.en: No. But she does need to wear glasses.
transcript.zh: 没有，不过她确实需要戴眼镜。

transcript.en: Oh I'll make a note of that.
transcript.zh: 哦，我会把这一点记下来的。

transcript.en: Yes she's pretty good about wearing them, she can't see much without them.
transcript.zh: 嗯，她还蛮喜欢戴眼镜的，不戴的话基本上什么都看不清。

transcript.en: Right.
transcript.zh: 好的。

transcript.en: OK.
transcript.zh: 好的。

transcript.en: Now	I also need emergency contact details.
transcript.zh: 现在我还需要一些紧急联系信息。

transcript.en: So what sort of information do you need?
transcript.zh: 你需要哪方面的信息呢？

transcript.en: Just the name and number of a friend or family member we can contact in case we can't get hold of you at any time.
transcript.zh: 就是我们可以联系的您的一个朋友或者家庭成员的名字和号码，以防我们联系不到您。

transcript.en: OK.
transcript.zh: 好的。

transcript.en: That'd better be my sister ...
transcript.zh: 好的，那最好填我姐姐的信息吧，

transcript.en: Jenny Ball That's B A double L.
transcript.zh: 她叫 Jenny Ball，姓的拼写是 BAdouble L，

transcript.en: Her phone number is 3346 7523.
transcript.zh: 她的电话号码是3346 7523。

transcript.en: Great.
transcript.zh: 很好

transcript.en: So she is the child's aunt?
transcript.zh: 所以，她是您孩子的阿姨？

transcript.en: Yes, that's right.
transcript.zh: 对，没错。

transcript.en: I'll make a note of that as well.
transcript.zh: 我把这个也写下来。

transcript.en: Now	 is there anything you'd like to ask?
transcript.zh: 好了，您有没有问题想要问我的？

transcript.en: What about payment?
transcript.zh: 怎么收费呢？

transcript.en: How much are the fees each term?
transcript.zh: 每学期多少钱？

transcript.en: Well, for two days and the hours you've chosen	 that will be $450 altogether.
transcript.zh: 按照您选择的这两天和托管时间来算的话，一共是450美元。

transcript.en: OK, and do I have to pay that now?
transcript.zh: 好的，我现在就要交钱吗？

transcript.en: No we send out invoices once the children start at the centre.
transcript.zh: 不用，孩子来了托儿所之后，我们会给您寄发票的。

transcript.en: You can choose to pay at the end of each term or we do offer a slightly discounted rate if you pay every month.
transcript.zh: 您可以选择每个学期末交钱或者，如果您每个月交一次的话，我们会稍微打个折。

transcript.en: Oh. I'll do that then.
transcript.zh: 哦，那我就每个月交一次吧。

transcript.en: I find it easier to budget that way and I'm not used to the term dates just yet.
transcript.zh: 我觉得这样比较好做预算，而且我还没习惯学期这种时间单位。

transcript.en: Good it makes it a lot simpler for us as well.
transcript.zh: 很好，这样对我们来说也更简单一些。

transcript.en: Well, that's everything.
transcript.zh: 那，这就是全部了。

transcript.en: Would you like me to show you around ...?
transcript.zh: 您需不需要我带你参观一下......？
